name: SQL migrations execute with strict NUMERIC types
title: SC-05-01-01 SQL migrations execute with strict NUMERIC types
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

When database migrations execute
Then the core tables are created
And all monetary balance columns are defined as NUMERIC(15,2)
And no FLOAT or DOUBLE PRECISION types exist in the schema
